Beginner.learningGoal: Prefer val, read-only collections and copy-based updates.
gotchas: List is a read-only view and may change if the backing MutableList changes
val reference does not make the object immutable
goodSolutionShows: Defensive copy (toList) when accepting a mutable list
shapeHints: a user profile with tag list

Intermediate.learningGoal: Build immutable models and update nested structures.
gotchas: Nested copy needs copy at each level
Exposing a MutableList through a List getter still allows casting abuse
goodSolutionShows: Private mutable backing field with a read-only exposure
shapeHints: updating a nested address inside a user
an immutable tree with path update
an inventory with add and remove returning new instances

Advanced.learningGoal: Implement persistent or structurally shared collections and thread-safe sharing of immutable state.
gotchas: Copying whole collections per update is O(n)
Mutable state hidden in lazy properties
Equality of immutable collections vs identity
goodSolutionShows: Structural sharing in a simple persistent stack or list
Tests for value-equality and non-mutation of the previous version
shapeHints: a persistent stack with push and pop
an undo stack of immutable states
